subject: general
question: Which football club clinched the I-League title in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gokulam Kerala FC.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• By defeating **East Bengal **in the semifinals and **Mohun Bagan** in the championship, **Gokulam Kerala** won the **2019 Durand Cup.**
 
• In the final game of the **2021–22 I–League**, they also triumphed over **Mohammedan** to secure their **second straight league championship**.
 
• Gokulam Kerala FC defeated Mohammedan Sporting of Kolkata to win the I-League championship once again.
 
• The I-League, which was founded in 2007, is the professional league for the Indian Men's Association football clubs.
 
• For Gokulam Kerala FC, Rishad and Emil Benny scored goals, while Marcus Joseph scored the sole goal for the opposing club.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohammedan Sporting**

 
 
• **​Mohammedan Sporting Club** is a multi-sports organisation with its headquarters in **Kolkata, West Bengal.** Its football squad competes in the C**alcutta Football Competition (CFL),** the oldest football competition in Asia, as well as the** I-League**, the second tier of Indian football.
 
• It is one of the nation's oldest functioning football clubs and was founded in February 1891.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan FC**
 
 
• ​The Indian professional football team **Rajasthan United FC **is in its fifth season, and this will be its second** I-League campaign.** Rajasthan United will take part in the **Durand Cup and the Super Cup** in addition to the I-League.
 
 
 
• **RoundGlass Punjab**
 
 
• Established in 2005 as **Minerva Academy FC,** **RoundGlass Punjab FC** is a professional football team with its home base in Mohali, Punjab.
 
• The academy-based club changed its name to **Minerva Punjab FC** in 2016, and the football division of the club changed its name to** Punjab FC** in 2019.
